name: permission-request-chime
description: Play a local sound whenever Codex creates a permission request.

interface.shortDescription: Play a chime when Codex asks for permission.
interface.longDescription: Permission Request Chime bundles a Codex PermissionRequest lifecycle hook that plays a local macOS sound as soon as an approval request is created. It is designed for users who miss permission popups when there is no audible cue.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure the permission request chime.
